title: Egyptian Spells for Scorpion Stings
hook: Ancient Egyptians didn't just carry medicine—they carried ivory wands to banish venomous snakes.

scenes.text: In ancient Egypt, medicine and magic were indistinguishable: doctors were simultaneously trained physicians and ordained priests of Sekhmet.

scenes.text: To treat stings, the Ebers Papyrus prescribed poultices of crushed garlic, beer dregs, and natron salts to draw out venom.
